verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe drafting feature revisions, requesting review, and requiring approval before publishing. Pricing lists 'Approval workflows' as a top-tier plan feature, and the API docs say risky changes can be held until a person confirms them. The approval gate itself is clearly documented, but nothing shows it can be scoped specifically to production-environment changes, and it is plan-gated. missing for 10: evidence that approvals can be required only for production-environment flag changes, detail on approver/reviewer configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing.
Continue adding changes to the draft, and when you're ready, publish them all at once with an optional commit message.
Require confirmation holds risky changes until a person confirms them in GrowthBook.
